# unroll

> Convert X/Twitter threads to clean markdown. No login, no API key, no tracking.

Powered by the public FxTwitter API. Built on Bun, open source (MIT).

## Usage

- Web UI: https://unroll.loa212.com/
- Prepend pattern: https://unroll.loa212.com/<any-tweet-url> (returns raw markdown)
- JSON API: GET https://unroll.loa212.com/api/thread?url=<tweet-url>&format=json
- Single tweet: GET https://unroll.loa212.com/api/tweet?url=<tweet-url>&format=json
- Health check: GET https://unroll.loa212.com/api/health
- MCP server: https://unroll.loa212.com/mcp (streamable HTTP; tools: unroll_thread, fetch_tweet)

## Rate limits

60 requests per hour per IP. Responses include RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, and RateLimit-Reset headers. Exceeding returns 429 with `{ "error": "rate_limited", "resetAt": <unix-ms> }`.

## Self-hosting

One `bun install` away. See the README for Docker and configuration details.

## Source

https://github.com/Loa212/unroll
